steps.title: Turn the bike over, open the quick release and drop the wheel out
steps.check_question: Are both fork ends empty, with no wheel between the fork blades?
steps.common_mistake: Flip the lever open first, then lift the frame so the wheel drops out.

steps.title: Unscrew the nut off the end of the skewer
steps.check_question: Is the nut off the skewer, held apart from the hub?
steps.common_mistake: Hold the lever still and turn the nut; it comes off in a few turns.

steps.title: Pull the skewer out and check both springs sit narrow end inward
steps.check_question: Is the skewer pulled out of the wheel, held apart from the hub?
steps.common_mistake: Keep both springs; each one points its narrow end toward the hub.

steps.title: Hold the wheel up, spin it and look over the tire and spokes
steps.common_mistake: Turn the wheel a full circle; look at the tread and both sidewalls.

steps.title: Set the wheel back between the fork blades
steps.check_question: Is the wheel sitting between the fork blades with the axle in the fork ends?
steps.common_mistake: Lower the fork onto the axle so it reaches the top of both slots.

steps.title: Run your fingers round the rim's braking track and the tire
steps.common_mistake: Feel the flat metal band the pads touch, all the way round.

steps.title: Check the brake pads line up with the rim
steps.common_mistake: Each pad should meet the flat braking track, not the tire.

steps.title: Slide the skewer back through the hub and thread the nut on
steps.check_question: Is the skewer through the hub with the lever on one side and the nut on the other?
steps.common_mistake: The lever goes on the left side of the bike, away from the chain.

steps.title: Snug the nut, then close the lever flat along the fork
steps.check_question: Is the quick release lever closed, lying flat along the fork blade?
steps.common_mistake: Fold the lever back along the fork. A lever pointing forward can catch and open.

steps.title: Turn the bike upright, spin the wheel and squeeze the brake
steps.check_question: Is the bike upright with the front wheel in the fork?
steps.common_mistake: Spin the wheel once and squeeze the brake before you ride.
